protocol: Separate 70/15/15 engine partitions within each supplied training subset. Fit regime clustering/normalisation and predictor on fit engines only. Validation and calibration each use one seeded uniform cutoff per engine after minimum history. Freeze all parameters before opening official test targets; evaluate each official test engine at its supplied endpoint. Short histories withheld and counted. Report capped primary and uncapped secondary error, constant fit-target baseline, empirical interval coverage/width and per-engine errors. No test-based tuning or cross-subset pooled scores.
limits: Research benchmark on simulated engine histories. Calibration random cutoffs and official endpoints may differ in distribution; report empirical coverage without claiming exchangeability or conditional guarantees. No operational error budgets, individual failure probabilities, diagnosis or serving-model promotion. FD001 remains historically inspected evidence from a different protocol/model.
